title: Rerun the Mica examples after the examples move
description: The examples moved from examples/demo/ and examples/real-world/ into one folder, examples/, with apps, tools and schema one level up, and every patch, example.json, generated page and script path rewritten. This reruns every constructed example of the subject system at the new layout, one step per example, to confirm that each still gives its expected verdict. Their pages were re-rendered from the old results with build.py --render-only, so a verdict that differs here is a regression of the move.
